title: Flockdeck team-wide changes
description: PLANNED CONTRACT, not served yet: every command and message here has status planned in api/catalog.json until the server builds it, and a client looks for the changes* names in the hello's api.caps before using any of them. The messages the Changes view reads: the changesTeam push (a watch of every agent checkout of a project, with files, checks, reviews, comments and the merge gate), a page of files (changesFiles), a file's diff as hunks (diffHunks), unchanged lines between hunks (diffContext) and the answer to a command that changes something (changesResult). The document root is changesTeam; the other shapes are in $defs. Desk only: a window through the relay is sent none of it. An object with a field not named here is not one Flockdeck writes. Optional fields are absent, never null. docs/changes-api.md explains each.

req.description: The req of the command, when it had one.

root.description: The project's directory, as the workspace spells it. Always written.

project.description: The project's name. May be empty.

rev.description: A number that goes up with each push of this watch. A client skips a push whose rev it has seen.

branches.description: One entry for each checkout of the project's agent panes that is in a git repository, at most 60, in the order of the team graph. Empty, never absent.

partial.description: Present when some checkouts could not be read in time.

lastCommit.description: The newest commit on the branch (stored: git).

subject.description: The first line of its message, cut to 200 characters.

pr.description: The pull request of the branch (stored: the GitHub integration, when it is on). Absent when there is none or the integration is off.

mergeable.description: Whether GitHub says it merges cleanly. The strings are written as shown; unknown while GitHub works it out.

reviewDecision.description: GitHub's review decision, empty when it has none. This is GitHub's, not the `reviews` of this contract.

conflictWith.description: Another branch that also changes the path (derived).

pane.description: The pane id of the other branch.

path.description: The path in the other branch. Differs from the file's own path when one side renamed it.

file.description: One changed file of a branch.

path.description: The path in the working tree, with forward slashes, relative to the repository root. Always written.

oldPath.description: The path before a rename or copy. Written for status R and C only.

status.description: Added, modified, deleted, renamed, copied or unmerged. Always written.

added.description: Lines added; 0 for a binary file. Always written.

removed.description: Lines removed; 0 for a binary file. Always written.

binary.description: Present, and true, for a binary file. Absent for text.

sizeBefore.description: Bytes before the change. Written for a binary file that existed before; absent otherwise.

sizeAfter.description: Bytes after the change. Written for a binary file that exists after; absent otherwise.

similarity.description: Percent of the content kept across a rename or copy. Written for status R and C only.

generated.description: Present, and true, for a file the path rules mark as generated (lockfiles, go.sum, vendored directories, minified bundles). A client may fold it. Absent otherwise.

modeChange.description: A change of file mode as 'old new' in octal, such as '100644 100755'. Absent when the mode is the same.

staged.description: Present, and true, when the change is in the index. Absent otherwise.

owner.description: The pane id that last changed the file on this branch (derived from the branch's panes; the branch's own pane when it is the only one). Absent when unknown.

conflictWith.description: Other branches that change the same path. Absent when there are none.

check.description: One check of a branch at its head.

startedAt.description: When it started. Absent while queued.

finishedAt.description: When it ended. Absent until pass, fail or skipped.

summary.description: One line, cut to 200 characters. May be empty.

source.description: local: a command of the project's gate.checks that Flockdeck ran. ci: a CI system's result. agent: a result an agent reported.

url.description: Where to read the full result. Absent when there is none.

atSha.description: The head the check ran against. A check whose atSha is not the branch's headSha is out of date; the server then reports it as queued again or leaves it out, never as pass.

review.description: A reviewer's sign-off on a branch.

state.description: requested: asked, no answer. approved. changes: changes requested. dismissed: withdrawn.

note.description: The reviewer's note, cut to 2000 characters. May be empty.

atSha.description: The head the reviewer looked at.

stale.description: Present, and true, when atSha is not the branch's headSha: a commit came after the review. A stale approval does not count. Written by the server so every client agrees.

comment.description: A review comment on one line of one file, sent to the file's owner.

id.description: The comment's id, assigned by the server.

path.description: The file the comment is on.

side.description: old: the line number is in the file before the change. new: after.

line.description: The line number on that side, from 1. 0 is a comment on the whole file.

atSha.description: The head the line numbers are for. A client may mark a comment whose atSha is not the headSha as outdated; the server does not move it.

author.description: you for the person at the window, else the pane id of the agent that wrote it.

to.description: The pane id the comment is routed to: the file's owner, else the branch's pane. Always written.

delivery.description: The newest delivery state of the message that carried the comment to `to`, with the meaning and order of the graph's message edges. Absent while it is being sent, which a client shows as sending.

state.description: open blocks the merge. fixed: the owner says it has dealt with it. resolved: closed by commentResolve. dismissed: closed as not needed. A reopened comment is open again.

fixedAtSha.description: The head at which the owner said it was fixed. Written for state fixed only.

blocker.description: One reason a branch cannot be merged yet.

kind.description: checks: one is not passing, or not run at this head. conflict: a path is changed by another branch, or does not merge with the base. review: a current review asks for changes. comments: a comment is open. unpushed: the head is not on the upstream. empty: the branch has no commits of its own.

text.description: One line naming what blocks, such as 'api also changes cfg/limits.yaml'.

gate.description: Where a branch stands against the merge gate (derived).

state.description: blocked: blockers is not empty. ready: nothing blocks, no approval yet. approved: the person approved headSha. merged: the branch is in the base.

blockers.description: Empty unless the state is blocked. Always written.

approvedBy.description: Who approved: you. Written for approved and merged.

approvedAt.description: When. Written for approved and merged.

approvedSha.description: The head that was approved. An approval for a head that is no longer current is dropped, and so is one when any blocker appears after it; the state goes back to ready or blocked. Written for approved and merged.

mergeSha.description: The commit the base is at after the merge. Written for merged only.

branch.description: One branch of the team, which is one pane's checkout.

pane.description: The pane the checkout belongs to. Always written, and unique in a push.

branch.description: The branch name. Absent for a detached head.

detached.description: Present, and true, when HEAD is on no branch.

base.description: The branch merges go into, usually main.

baseSha.description: The merge base of the branch and `base`.

upstream.description: The upstream branch. Absent when there is none.

ahead.description: Commits ahead of the upstream; of `base` when there is no upstream.

taskId.description: The task the pane works on, from the board. Absent for none.

files.description: The changed files, most changed first (lines added plus removed, then path), at most 2000. Committed changes since baseSha and uncommitted changes together; a file in both appears once.

omitted.description: Files left out of `files` because of the limit. Absent at 0.

checks.description: The branch's checks at headSha. Empty when the project defines none.

comments.description: All comments of the branch, newest first, at most 500.

error.description: Why this checkout could not be read, such as the directory being gone. When set, only pane, cwd and error are written.

changesTeam.description: The push a window gets after changesWatch, and in answer to changesSnapshot, for one project.

req.description: The req of the command, when it had one.

root.description: The project's directory, as the workspace spells it. Always written.

project.description: The project's name. May be empty.

rev.description: A number that goes up with each push of this watch. A client skips a push whose rev it has seen.

branches.description: One entry for each checkout of the project's agent panes that is in a git repository, at most 60, in the order of the team graph. Empty, never absent.

partial.description: Present when some checkouts could not be read in time.

changesFiles.description: A page of one branch's files, in answer to filesPage.

files.description: The page, in the order of the branch's `files`.

t.description: A context line, an added line or a deleted line.

text.description: The line without its end of line.

oldNo.description: The line number before the change, from 1. Written for ctx and del.

newNo.description: The line number after the change, from 1. Written for ctx and add.

intra.description: Word-level changes inside a changed line as [start, end) pairs in Unicode code points of `text`. Written for add and del lines that pair with a line on the other side; absent otherwise.

oldStart.description: First line on the old side, from 1; 0 when the old side is empty.

newStart.description: First line on the new side; 0 when empty.

header.description: The text git puts after the @@ range, such as a function name. May be empty.

diffHunks.description: A file's diff as hunks, in answer to diffHunks.

oldPath.description: The path before a rename. Absent otherwise.

against.description: What the diff is against, as asked.

binary.description: Present, and true, for a binary file: hunks is then empty and sizeBefore and sizeAfter are written.

sizeBefore.description: Bytes before, for a binary file.

sizeAfter.description: Bytes after, for a binary file.

eolChange.description: Present, and true, when the file's line endings changed. When that is the only change, hunks is empty.

hunks.description: In file order. Empty, never absent.

totalLines.description: The lines the whole diff has, counting those left out by truncated.

truncated.description: Present when the diff was cut: hunks holds the first lines and no more.

error.description: Why the diff could not be made. When set, only type, req, pane, path and error are written.

diffContext.description: Unchanged lines between hunks, in answer to diffContext.

lines.description: The lines asked for, all ctx, fewer if the file ended.

eof.description: True when the last line of the file is in `lines`.

error.description: Why the lines could not be read. When set, lines is empty.

changesResult.description: The answer to a command that changes something, and the refusal of any changes command.

req.description: The req of the command, when it had one.

code.description: Why it was refused. Written when ok is false. deskOnly: a window through the relay. unsupported: this build does not do it yet (see caps). badRequest: a field is missing, too long or out of range. noBranch: no such pane or branch. headMoved: expectSha is not the head. checksNotPassing: a check is failing, running, queued or missing at this head. conflicts. openComments. reviewChangesRequested. unpushed: the head is not on the upstream. empty: the branch has no commits of its own. notApproved: mergeBranch, and the gate is not approved for that head. notFound: no such comment, a reviewer that is missing or not an agent pane, or no team file for runChecks. notClean: the base checkout has uncommitted changes. notFastForward: the base moved, so the branch needs the base merged into it first. failed: git refused, and error has its words.

error.description: A sentence a window can show. Written when ok is false.
